children: Overview
Hong Kong engineering services firm's H1 revenue rose 6% yr/yr
Profit attributable to owners more than doubled yr/yr
Gross profit declined to HK$387.8 mln from HK$484.3 mln yr/yr
Outlook
Analogue Holdings aims to fully deploy HK$59.8 mln of unutilised listing proceeds on acquisitions or investments by 31 Dec 2027
Result Drivers
ENVIRONMENTAL ENGINEERING PROJECT EXECUTION - Company said revenue growth was primarily driven by steady project execution in the Environmental Engineering segment

NCA STAKE DISPOSAL - Company said profit was partly attributable to the disposal of about 3% equity stake in associate Nanjing Canatal Data-Centre Environmental Tech Co., Ltd., which generated a gain of HK$112.7 million
BUILDING SERVICES PROJECT EXECUTION - Company said revenue growth was primarily driven by steady project execution in the Building Services segment
